name: busybuddy
description: BusyBuddy — conversion widgets for Shopify stores. Full-stack app (React + TS + Vite + Tailwind frontend, Node + Express + TS backend).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
